resale_co.name: Certificate of Continuing Occupancy (CCO) / Certificate of Resale/Rental Residential Property
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Rockleigh Construction Office (Construction Official)
resale_co.lead_time: Inspections are conducted Monday through Friday between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m.
requirements: Written application by the owner or agent, saying whether the property is to be sold
General inspection showing no apparent violations and no pending violations, orders or open matters with the Construction Official
Use of the building must have existed before (no unapproved change of use)

fees.label: Inspection / CCO issuance, residential resale or rental
fees.quote: The fee for the inspection / CCO issuance is $150.00.

fees.label: Certificate of continued occupancy letter (Borough Code Section 9-1.3)
fees.quote: The fee for a certificate of continued occupancy letter shall be $150.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the Application for Certificate of Resale/Rental Residential Property from the Borough's Forms & Permits page, fill in owner, buyer and inspection-day contact, and submit it to the Construction Office, 26 Rockleigh Road, Rockleigh, NJ 07647, with a $150.00 check payable to the Borough of Rockleigh.

evidence.quote: Any such vacation, sale or change of use without obtaining a certificate of continuing occupancy shall constitute a violation of this Article and subject the owner or occupier to the penalties provided in § 34-57.
The certificate of continuing occupancy shall evidence only that a general inspection has been made and that there are no apparent violations of the applicable laws or ordinances.
Application for Certificate of Resale/Rental Residential Property
Inspections are conducted Monday through Friday between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m.
Application for Certificate of Resale/Rental Residential Property

resale_co.notes: Borough Code Section 34-43 (Zoning, Certificate of Occupancy) requires a certificate of continuing occupancy when a building is sold, and Section 9-1.3 sets the CCO letter fee at $150 (fee section amended 9-8-2025 by Ord. No. 2025-6). Both were read through ecode360. The Borough application PDF is a scanned image, so its quotes were read visually and an automated text check will not find them. The Borough office phone (201-768-4217) and email (clerk@rockleighnj.org) are general Borough contacts. William McGuire is listed as Construction Official, Construction/Zoning Official and Fire Official; there is no separate email for him on the Borough site (the state directory lists wmcguire@rockleighnj.org).

requirements: Smoke alarm on each level and outside each separate sleeping area, near the bedrooms (Borough code)
Carbon monoxide detectors as required by N.J.S.A. 52:27D-133.3
Portable fire extinguisher (ABC type, no larger than 10 pounds, mounted within 10 feet of the kitchen) (Borough code still lists it)

authorities.name: Rockleigh Fire Prevention Bureau (Borough of Rockleigh)
authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on business days between the application and the change of occupant: more than 10 business days for the lowest fee.

fees.label: Smoke detector compliance certificate, application more than 10 business days before change of occupant
fees.quote: More than 10 business days prior to change of occupant: $50.00

fees.label: Application four to 10 business days before change of occupant
fees.quote: Four to 10 business days prior to change of occupant: $100.00

fees.label: Application less than four business days before change of occupant
fees.quote: Less than four business days prior to change of occupant: $150.00

authorities.how_to_apply: Contact the Borough office at 26 Rockleigh Road (201-768-4217). No separate smoke/CO application form is posted; it is likely handled with the CCO inspection by William McGuire, but confirm.
authorities.contact_title: Fire Inspector/Prevention Official (Alternate Fire Inspector: Kenneth Shepard)

evidence.quote: In the case of change of occupancy of any building subject to the requirements of subsection 11-1.9, no owner shall sell, lease or otherwise permit occupancy for residential purposes of that building without first obtaining from the Rockleigh Fire Prevention Bureau a certificate evidencing compliance with the requirements of this chapter and N.J.S.A. 52:27D-198.1 and 52:27D-198.2.
The fee will be based on when the application is received:

LEAID: 0255-001 Rockleigh Boro ... Name: Rockleigh Boro Fire Prev ... Enf Auth. Municipal Addr: 26 Rockleigh Rd ... Fire Official William Mc Guire Phone (201) 768-4217 ... Email wmcguire@rockleighnj.org

fire_cert.notes: The tiered fees come from Borough Code Section 11-1.10 (Chapter 11, Fire Protection and Prevention), read through ecode360. The Borough website does not say whether the smoke/CO certificate fee is charged on top of the $150.00 CCO fee or is included in it, so confidence is medium. The code still requires a portable fire extinguisher; the state dropped it from the sale certificate in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19). The code also lets the Fire Official buy and install required smoke detectors for $40.00 each.

open_questions: Is the smoke/CO certificate fee ($50 / $100 / $150 by timing) charged in addition to the $150.00 CCO fee, or is it covered by it?
